notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated); the insurance notes repeat the tables per portfolio after the totals. Text layer; figures read from the page text (file page numbers; printed folio + 1 = file page). Reviewed, not audited (KPMG). Units differ: the SCI (three months p.6, six months p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. Revenue 9.1.1 six months p.147 and PAA revenue and expenses p.148 (columns non-participating / participating / PAA / total). The total CSM roll-forward 'กระทบยอดการวัดมูลค่าองค์ประกอบ... - ไม่รวมสัญญาที่วัดมูลค่าภายใต้วิธีการปันส่วนเบี้ยประกันภัย' (30 มิถุนายน 2568) runs over p.76-78; new business p.82. The opening CSM is printed 3,140,270 here (1Q2025: 3,140,271). Future-service change = change in estimates (the onerous-contract line has no CSM). The CSM insurance-finance row is 171,736 for the six months (1Q2025: (57,769)): recorded as printed. The income tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', prints the six-month credit in brackets and the three-month expense without (profit before tax -/+ the line = net profit); both take sign -1. RA release uses 9.1.1 (18,740), equal to the AOC RA. Other revenue = อื่นๆ (9.1.1, nil). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2568 (p.6).
